items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Foster Bailey, I believe. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Right here on his tongue. I remember we used to play, uh, the blues and I'd hold a note like I heard that client, they'd play a hold on it on that blues. I had a record there where a guy holds a note on the planet. I don't get his name. He's a white boy. No, I don't. Maybe he's white. I don't know.
